text:
sara: Quick heads-up 10 chart clutter issue: when users pin >5 series the left axis eats too much space. Proposing three small patterns to test: 1) floating 'Unit' pill (top-right) that shows full unit on focus, 2) inline compact ticks (k/M) with an accessible abbr, 3) adaptive truncation that adds ellipsis but reveals full label on keyboard focus.

omar: +1 on the pill for dense dashboards. It isolates unit copy from tick density. Make it move into the legend area on <420px widths.

ben: A11y note: whichever we pick, ensure screen readers always get the full axis label via aria-label on the axis container. Do NOT rely on :hover-only tooltips.

tess: Outliers: prefer a "soft fade" (alpha down) for values beyond a threshold, not re-scaling. Rescaling hides context. Also add a setting called "De-emphasize extreme values (visual only)" — avoid words like hide/suppress.

milo: For smoothing: default OFF for dashboard timeseries. Consider a microchart rule: small inline sparklines can default to ON. Smoothing should be client-side and layered (visual only) so hover still shows raw points.

sara: UX test idea: run a 6-person study with two tasks: (A) identify the highest spike in last 24h, (B) read axis unit. Variants: pill + fade, inline abbr + fade, truncation + no-fade. Measure speed + confidence.

omar: Quick CSS starter for pill mobility:

```css
.unit-pill{position:absolute;right:12px;top:8px;background:#f7fafc;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:420px){.unit-pill{position:static;margin-left:8px}}
```

ben: Implementation perf: fade is cheap; caps/inset views are expensive to draw every frame and complicate hit-testing. If we later add caps, prefer canvas layer for markers.

tess: Copy microcopy: try two phrasings for the setting: (1) "De-emphasize extreme values (visual only)" (2) "Compact outliers visually (does not remove data)". I'll draft tooltip lines.

sara: Decision for prototyping: build pill + soft-fade variant first and a inline-abbr + soft-fade second. Prioritize keyboard focus and SR announcements. Kai will mock visuals; @ben will write perf notes.

design-bot: New mock link from kai: https://redwood-inference.design/mocks/axis-pill-fade-2026-03-23.png :frame_with_picture: 

sara: Action items:

- ben: perf notes & canvas vs svg suggestions (Thu)

sara: Thanks team :thumbsup:
